Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice H.T. Narendra Prasad
 Oral Judgment
1.
The learned counsel Sri H.P.Leeladha, for appellants has submitted that the parties have settled the matter in Ex.No.365/2018 before the Tribunal.
Therefore, these appeals do not survive for consideration.
2. Submission of learned counsel Sri H.P.Leeladha, is taken on record.
3. Accordingly, the appeals are disposed of in terms of settlement between the parties.

The amount in deposit, if any, is ordered to be refunded in favour of appellant No.1-Basavaraju,
i.e. the owner of the offending vehicle, after due verification.
5. All pending applications, if any, are also disposed of in both the appeals.

Sd/-
